messages.subject: ESG & Sustainability Executive | External Affairs, Stakeholder & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Thaddeus,

Heron Search's work across sustainability, ESG and senior leadership is relevant to my background in responsible mining and institutional engagement. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where sustainability strategy must connect regulators, communities and business execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
